anyOf.description: An allowlisted key's string value, cut to 256 characters.
Any other key or value: the key name only.

ContextValue.description: A request context value as the start line keeps it.

EndArtifact.description: One result artifact on the end line.

path.description: Path relative to the artifact root; absent for a path outside it.

retryable.description: Whether a consumer-level retry is considered safe.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage where the failure surfaced.

artifacts.description: Result artifacts, with paths relative to the artifact root.

container_oom_kills.description:
The container's cgroup v2 `oom_kill` count, read with `resources`.
After a crashed host's exit, a larger count read then replaces it.
Best effort: the kernel can count a kill after the host's exit is
seen.

elapsed_ms.description: Monotonic time from the start line to the end line, in milliseconds.

error.description: Error code, stage and retryable flag, without the message.

resources.description:
The runtime's process values when the invocation ended, read under
the runtime's host lock right after the adapter host answered or the
timeout fired.

status.description: Final status. A Fabric lifecycle error, such as a host timeout, reads `failed`.

stop.description: Why the invocation stopped; absent when it holds nothing, as on success.

usage.description: Numeric usage counters, without adapter metadata.

EndUsage.description: The end line's usage: the numeric `RunUsage` fields.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens reported by the provider.

ErrorStage.description: NeMo Fabric lifecycle stage associated with an error.

oneOf.description: Configuration resolution failed.
Effective config planning failed.
Environment preparation failed.
Runtime start/connect failed.
Runtime invocation failed.
Runtime stop/detach failed.
Environment release failed.
Artifact collection or writing failed.
Wall-clock time.

NotRecorded.description: Marks a key whose value the record leaves out.

anyOf.description: The count could not be read.

reason.description: Why the count could not be read.

OomKills.description:
The cgroup v2 `memory.events` `oom_kill` count of the container Fabric
runs in, or why it could not be read.

OomKillsUnavailable.description: Why the container's `oom_kill` count could not be read.

oneOf.description: The operating system has no cgroup v2 source.
The host uses cgroup v1.

Fabric does not run at the root of its own cgroup, or the cgroup files
cannot be read.
`nemo.fabric.run_record`.
`v1alpha1`.

error.description: Why no snapshot could be read.

Resources.description:
A runtime resource snapshot, or the error code that explains why none
could be read.

ResourcesError.description: Error codes for a snapshot that could not be read.

oneOf.description:
The runtime stopped or is stopping, its adapter host exited, a live
process in its tree or the process table cannot be read, or the
process tree kept changing during the read.

The adapter kind, environment provider, or operating system has no
resource reader.
The harness completed successfully.
The harness completed with a non-zero status.
The invocation or runtime was cancelled.

RuntimeResourceSnapshot.description:
Timestamped resource usage of one runtime's local adapter host process tree.

Memory, process count, and CPU time cover the adapter host process and its
live descendants. For a runtime started on a service, the shared service
process is not included. Values NeMo Fabric cannot read are returned as an
error, never as zero.

cpu_time_seconds.description:
CPU time consumed by the tree since the adapter host started, in seconds,
including exited descendants. It can drop when a descendant leaves the
tree.

observed_at.description: When NeMo Fabric read these values, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

process_count.description:
Live processes in the tree, including the adapter host. Exited processes
that are not yet reaped are not counted.

resident_memory_bytes.description:
Sum of the resident set sizes of the live processes, in bytes. Pages
shared between processes count once per process.

started_at.description: When NeMo Fabric started the runtime's adapter host, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

elapsed_ms.description: Monotonic time since the start line, in milliseconds.

container_oom_kills.description: The container's cgroup v2 `oom_kill` count when the invocation started.

context.description:
`RunRequest.context`. Allowlisted identity and Harbor link keys keep a
string or integer value; every other key is listed by name only.

exclusive_container.description:
`runtime.record.exclusive_container`: whether a rise in
`container_oom_kills` can set the `sandbox_failed` cause.

fabric_version.description: NeMo Fabric version that wrote the record.

models.description: Configured models by role: provider and model name only.

override_keys.description:
Top-level key names of `RunRequest.overrides`, sorted. Values are never
recorded.

resources.description: The runtime's process values when the invocation started.

sample_interval_ms.description:
Interval between sample lines, in milliseconds. Absent when this
process has no sample thread, so the record gets no sample lines.

timeout_ms.description: Host invocation timeout that applied, in milliseconds.

cause.description: Fabric's failure cause; absent on a cancel alone.

exit_code.description: The adapter host's exit code, when it exited.

exit_signal.description: The signal that ended the adapter host, when one did.

forced.description:
Whether Fabric force-stopped the adapter host. After a forced stop on
Linux and macOS, `exit_signal` is usually the signal Fabric sent (9),
unless the host exited by itself during the 2-second grace period.

limit.description: The limit that ended the invocation.

reason.description: What stopped the invocation, when a limit did.

StopCause.description: Fabric's own closed list of failure causes.

oneOf.description:
Core or the adapter host raised an error other than a timeout or a
host exit, such as an invalid adapter result or an adapter crash
inside the host. An error from the exchange with the host during an
out-of-memory rise in an exclusive container reads `SandboxFailed`.

The container's `oom_kill` count rose and
`runtime.record.exclusive_container` is set.
A limit ended the invocation, such as Fabric's timeout.
The adapter host exited, or nothing else matched.
The adapter returned a failed result.

StopLimit.description: The limit that ended an invocation.

usage.description:
What the invocation used when it stopped, in the same unit. For a
forced stop, the time until core's timeout fired.

value.description:
The configured limit, in milliseconds for `time`: the invoke timeout
that applied, `runtime.timeout_seconds` or 1 hour when it is unset.
Core gives the adapter an earlier deadline, the timeout less
10 seconds and at least half of it.

oneOf.description: The invocation reached its time limit.

description: One line of a run record.

oneOf.description: Written once, before core sends the request to the adapter host.

Written about every 10 s until the exchange with the adapter host
ends, when the start line has `sample_interval_ms`. A recent sample
shows that Fabric observed the record recently, not that the agent is
making progress.
Written once, after the invocation returned a result or failed.

time.description: UTC wall-clock time the line was written, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

version.description:
Line format version. `v1alpha1` may change until the `nemo-fabric report`
command ships.
